note: Real provider events observed during development, kept as dated evidence. The behaviours are proven deterministically by tests/chaos/test_provider_fallback.py; these records corroborate, they do not prove.

events.detail: OpenRouter authenticated but returned HTTP 402 (credit exhausted); the chain fell through to Groq, which answered. primary -> secondary, against real providers.
Requests sent as Python-urllib/3.x were rejected with HTTP 403 and Cloudflare code 1010, indistinguishable from a bad credential. Fixed by sending a real User-Agent.
